steps.label: Eevee-Render 240 Frames
steps.run:
cat > evtest.py <<'EOF_EV'
import bpy, json, os, time, sys
argv = sys.argv[sys.argv.index('--') + 1:]
out = argv[0]
FPS = 24
A = json.load(open(os.environ['CT_ROOT'] + '/ct/shots.json'))['anim']
COLS = {'colB': A['colB'], 'colY': A['colY']}
def iseq(seq, t):
    if t <= seq[0][0]: return seq[0][1]
    for (t0, v0), (t1, v1) in zip(seq, seq[1:]):
        if t0 <= t <= t1:
            u = (t - t0) / (t1 - t0); u = u * u * (3 - 2 * u); return v0 + (v1 - v0) * u
    return seq[-1][1]
def upd(scene, *a):
    t = (scene.frame_current - 1) / FPS
    for n, seq in COLS.items():
        o = bpy.data.objects[n]; c = int(round(iseq(seq, t)))
        o.hide_render = c < 1; o.modifiers['arr'].count = max(1, c)
bpy.app.handlers.frame_change_pre.append(upd)
sc = bpy.context.scene
for e in ('BLENDER_EEVEE_NEXT', 'BLENDER_EEVEE'):
    try:
        sc.render.engine = e; break
    except Exception as ex: print('engine skip', e, ex)
print('ENGINE', sc.render.engine)
ee = sc.eevee
for k, v in [('taa_render_samples', 48), ('use_raytracing', True), ('use_shadows', True), ('use_gtao', True), ('use_bloom', True), ('shadow_ray_count', 2), ('shadow_step_count', 8)]:
    try: setattr(ee, k, v)
    except Exception as ex: print('skip', k, ex)
try:
    ee.ray_tracing_options.resolution_scale = '1'
except Exception as ex: print('skip rt res', ex)
sc.render.resolution_x = 1080; sc.render.resolution_y = 1920; sc.render.resolution_percentage = 100
sc.render.use_motion_blur = True
sc.frame_start = 1; sc.frame_end = 240
ims = sc.render.image_settings
if hasattr(ims, 'media_type'): ims.media_type = 'VIDEO'
ims.file_format = 'FFMPEG'
sc.render.ffmpeg.format = 'MPEG4'; sc.render.ffmpeg.codec = 'H264'
try: sc.render.ffmpeg.constant_rate_factor = 'PERC_LOSSLESS'
except Exception: pass
sc.render.filepath = out
t0 = time.time()
bpy.ops.render.render(animation=True)
dt = time.time() - t0
print('EEVEE_TIME total %.1f s, per frame %.2f s' % (dt, dt / 240))
open(os.environ['CT_ROOT'] + '/timing.txt', 'w').write('EEVEE %s total %.1f s per frame %.2f s\n' % (sc.render.engine, dt, dt / 240))
EOF_EV
CT_ROOT=$PWD /Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender -b ct/scene.blend -P evtest.py -- $PWD/ev_ > ev.log 2>&1; grep -aE 'ENGINE|EEVEE_TIME|skip|Error' ev.log | head -12; f=$(ls ev_*.mp4 | head -1); test -n "$f" && mv "$f" eevee.mp4 && cat timing.txt
